title: Kanum, Smärky Language (KXQ)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Smärky Kanum is an endangered indigenous language of Indonesia. It belongs to the South-Central Papuan language family. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people. It is not known to be taught in schools.

title: Smärky Kanum
text: Alternate names: Kanum, Kanum, Smärky. Language code: kxq. Language family: South-Central Papuan, Morehead-Upper Maro, Tonda (SIL classification). Number of speakers: 80.
